title: Easier category management
items: Manage Categories has a search box that stays at the top while you scroll the list.
The + New button opens a small window to type the new category name.

title: Inventory header fits small screens
items: On phones, the Inventory tabs and the Print and Import / Export buttons now wrap onto extra lines instead of being cut off.

title: Better phone layout
items: The bottom menu is gone on phones. Everything, including Sign Out, is in the side menu.
The dashboard fits the screen, with stat cards in two columns and a table you can swipe sideways.
The side menu and pop-up windows scroll by touch, and search boxes fill the row.

title: Loyalty for every store, grouped permissions
items: The loyalty program is now included for every store and is no longer an add-on.
Role permissions are grouped into dropdowns with a count for each group, and a search box to find one quickly.
Role cards show one chip per group instead of a long row of tags.

title: Easier member sign-up
items: Only the first and last name are needed to add a member. Phone, email and birthday are optional.
View Transactions on a member shows their purchase history and redemption history in one window.

title: Separate customer lists and one discount per sale
items: Invoice customers and loyalty members are now separate lists. Checkout only offers members, and invoices only offer invoice customers.
Deleting an invoice customer or a loyalty member asks for a reason and is logged.
Only one discount applies to a sale: a cart discount, a voucher or the birthday discount.
At checkout, the search box shows the newest members when you click it.

title: Select products on invoices
items: New invoices have a Select products window like the purchase order one. It only lists products that are visible in the POS and in stock, and quantities can't go above the stock.

title: Price adjustments by order type, and in reports
items: Order types you add can change prices (auto markup or custom price) like order sources. When both are set, the order source is used.
Reports and shift reports show price adjustments per order source and order type. Receipts never show them.

title: Discounts in reports
items: The dashboard and Reports show discounts given, split into Senior, PWD, manual, voucher and birthday, with a list by cashier and every discounted order.
Shift reports, end-of-shift, the BIR tab, the sales report (print, email and PDF) include discounts. Gross profit and product sales are after discounts.
The daily summary email and its PDF list discounts too.

title: Promo vouchers and member points
items: New Vouchers tab in Loyalty: create promo vouchers with a code, fixed or percent discount, optional cap and minimum purchase, valid dates, and limits on total uses and uses per member. See where each one was used.
Add or remove a member's points by hand, with a required reason and a history on the member.
The birthday discount is now announced when the member is picked, shown in the cart, and applied by default.
Voucher and birthday discount lines always stay on one line on thermal receipts.

title: Loyalty program update
items: Loyalty now has Members, Redeem, Rewards and Setup screens, each with its own role permission.
Every member gets a member ID that can be scanned at checkout to pick the customer.
Members have a first name, last name, optional name extension, phone and email. Possible duplicates are flagged.
Fixed: points on preorders are now credited when the balance is collected, and a voucher used on a preorder can no longer be used twice.
Redeeming is refused if the member's points changed on another device.

title: Smarter receiving
items: Receiving a purchase order matches each item to your inventory by SKU, then name. Confirm the match, find another, or mark it as not in inventory.
Optionally use the supplier or warehouse SKU on a matched product, and create missing products with your store's own SKU and the warehouse price as cost and retail.
Receiving also updates the cost price of matched products.

title: Activity log
items: New Activity log screen shows who did what: sign-ins, orders, payments, item and stock changes, customers, staff, devices and settings. Filter by type, search, or pick dates.
Only the owner sees it by default. The owner can allow it for a staff member with the new "See the activity log" permission in Settings, Staff & roles.

title: New app icon
items: NJ POS has a refreshed app icon. If you installed the app, the new icon appears after the update (on some phones you may need to reinstall it to see it on the home screen).

title: Installable app and a clearer update notice
items: NJ Warehouse can now be installed like an app (Install button on Chrome and Edge, Add to Home Screen on iPhone and iPad).
The "Update now" notice is a floating box at the top right, stays until you press Update now, and links to these update records.

title: Set up devices with an emailed code, and faster sync
items: Adding a device now works like NJ POS: enter the owner's email, see the allowed and active devices, then Set up here, Restore as this device or Remove Device with a 6-digit code sent to the owner's email.
Devices notice each other's work within a few seconds (approvals, stock, payments) instead of waiting for the next refresh.

title: Free 3-day trial
items: Get a free 3-day trial code from nj-systems.com. The 3 days start when you register, and the trial includes 1 device.

title: Order emails with a PDF
items: New stock request and fulfilled order emails list the first 10 items and attach a PDF with the full order.
Amounts in the emails now show thousands separators.

title: Plain money boxes
items: Payment, discount and price boxes no longer have up and down arrows.

title: Instant discounts
items: Adding or removing a discount on an order shows right away, without a "saved" popup.

title: Order window, invoice footer and signers
items: The order window keeps a fixed size and only the items scroll, and it shows Subtotal, Discount and Total clearly.
Invoices can have your own footer message (or none) and up to 4 signature lines, set in Settings, Billing & printing.

title: Select products on new orders
items: New orders are built with a Select products window with checkboxes, quantities and search.

title: Stock alert emails
items: Turn the daily low-stock email on or off and choose up to 5 addresses, in Settings, Stock alerts.

title: NJ Warehouse emails
items: Warehouse emails use the NJ WAREHOUSE header and an NJ Systems footer.

title: Customers, discounts and invoices
items: Customers with balances, discounts, payment types, invoice printing settings and a store price list.

title: Bulk edit
items: Select items in Inventory and edit many of them at once in a spreadsheet-style window.

title: Receiving waits for the warehouse
items: A purchase order sent to your connected warehouse can only be received after the warehouse marks it fulfilled. Until then the Receiving tab shows "Waiting for the warehouse to fulfil this order" instead of the Receive button.

title: Payments tabs: pay from the list
items: The Payments tab of Purchase Orders and Invoices now lists each document with total, paid, balance and status, with a Pay button.
Filter by Unpaid & partial (the default), Unpaid, Partially paid, Fully paid or All. The old list of payment records is under Payment history.
Payment amount boxes are plain text boxes without the up/down arrows.

title: Purchase orders: items come from Select products
items: Items on a purchase order are now added only with Select products; the line-by-line search and Add Item button are gone.
After choosing, the button reads Update Selected Products so the selection can be changed.

title: Select products on purchase orders
items: New Select products button on a purchase order opens the supplier's price list (or your inventory) with checkboxes and quantities, so several items can be added at once.
The list has a search box and a fixed-size window: the header and the confirm button stay in place while the items scroll.

title: Daily report to several emails
items: The scheduled daily report can be sent to up to 5 email addresses. Add them in Settings, Order Settings, Scheduled Daily Report.

title: Update details on the website
items: "Click here to view the details" now opens the update records on nj-systems.com.

title: Update notice stays until you update
items: The update box no longer has a close button: it stays on screen until Update now is pressed.
After the app updates, a short "NJ POS was updated" notice links to what changed.

title: Update notice moved to the corner
items: The "new version" notice is now a small floating box at the top right, so it no longer sits behind other banners.
Closing the notice does not stop the update: it still installs by itself when the device is idle.

title: Safer developer support
items: Developer support sessions use their own temporary device, so a real device of your store is never renamed or removed.
Update checks now compare build numbers correctly (build 10 is newer than build 9).

title: Developer access: View and Support
items: Read-only View and full Support are separate options, and View can show the app as a chosen device and its signed-in user without changing anything.

title: Developer access banner
items: Developer access shows a floating banner with the store, end time and an Exit button.

title: Ongoing shift reminder
items: If a shift from an earlier day is still open, a popup shows when it started and lets you continue it or end it.
The shift popup also appears after a restored login.

title: Portrait reports
items: Report PDFs from the POS are always portrait.

title: Supplier printing
items: Printing moved into the supplier catalog views; a warehouse catalog prints its own products.

title: Purchase orders
items: A supplier with a price list only offers the items on that list.

title: Purchase orders to a connected warehouse
items: Items must be picked from the warehouse price list, at the warehouse's prices.

title: Warehouse connection
items: Connecting falls back to the company name when needed.

title: Warehouse orders
items: Warehouse orders show status badges and refresh by themselves.
Mark Sent sends first and shows clear errors if it fails.

title: Automatic updates
items: Idle devices install a waiting update by themselves, never during an open sale.

title: End-of-shift report
items: End of shift has an "Email me" button that sends the shift report with a PDF copy to the account email.
The shift report lists products sold.
